title: The norm principle for extended Clifford groups
summary: We prove the norm principle for the extended Clifford group $Ω(q)$ of every nondegenerate quadratic form $q$ of even dimension at least $4$ over an arbitrary field $F$ of characteristic different from $2$, for all finite separable field extensions $L/F$. The main new ingredient is a factorization theorem for proper similitudes: for a quadratic extension $L/F$ and $f\in \mathrm{GO}^+(q)(L)$, there exist $u\in \mathrm{SO}(q)(L)$, a maximal $F$-torus $S\subset \mathrm{GO}^+(q)$, and $s\in S(L)$ such that $f=us$.
